body:
The null BC check is missing from the `iframe` post-connection steps. Can you add that there?

<details>
<summary>AI review</summary>

The `iframe` [post-connection steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/iframe-embed-object.html#the-iframe-element) call [create a new child navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-sequences.html#create-a-new-child-navigable) unconditionally, and its step 2 is:

> Let *group* be *element*'s node document's browsing context's top-level browsing context's group.

For an `iframe` inserted into a document without a browsing context (e.g. from `createHTMLDocument()`), that dereferences null.

Before #10840 the steps started with:

> If *insertedNode*'s shadow-including root's browsing context is null, then return.

The second commit there, "Remove is-connected precondition", dropped it. Post-connection steps only run for connected nodes, so the connectedness half was redundant, but the browsing context half was also removed. The pre-#10188 text, "inserted into a document whose browsing context is non-null", had the check from the start.

This is exercised in the third subtest of web-platform-tests/wpt#62622.

</details>
